GROK 4.5 IS NOW ON THE FRONTIERCODE LEADERBOARD
Cognition just launched the FrontierCode leaderboard — a new benchmark specifically designed to track which AI models are writing code you’d actually merge into production.
Unlike many synthetic benchmarks, FrontierCode focuses on real-world usability, with full methodology and sample tasks publicly available.
Grok 4.5 is included in the rankings alongside other top models.
This is another step toward measuring what actually matters for developers: code that works, integrates cleanly, and solves real problems.

TESLA’S NEXT-GEN OPTIMUS V3 HAND IS GETTING CLOSE TO HUMAN-LEVEL

Tesla engineers just shared new details on the Optimus V3 hand — and the progress is striking.

They’re now saying that as they move into Gen-3 and mass production, the hand is getting very close to human functionality and form factor.

One engineer described it clearly:
“It won’t even look like a robot. It will look like a human in a superhero suit. It will be something revolutionary.”

This level of dexterity and human-like design is a critical milestone. The hand is one of the hardest parts of building a truly useful humanoid robot — and Tesla is iterating extremely fast.

Video

OPTIMUS WILL BE ONE OF THE MOST POSITIVE TECHNOLOGIES FOR HUMANITY

Tesla’s Optimus robot has the potential to fundamentally improve quality of life on a global scale.

Here’s why it matters:
• It can take over dangerous, repetitive, and physically demanding jobs that humans currently have to do

• It can help address severe labor shortages, especially in countries facing population decline and aging societies

• It has the potential to dramatically increase productivity, which could lead to greater abundance and lower costs for goods and services
• In the long term, it could free up human time and energy for more creative, meaningful, and fulfilling work
• It will also play a critical role in building infrastructure on Earth and eventually helping establish a presence on Mars
Instead of replacing humans in a negative way, Optimus is designed to expand what humanity is capable of achieving. By handling the work that limits us today, it can accelerate progress in almost every field.
When labor becomes abundant and cheap through robotics, many of the constraints we face as a civilization start to dissolve.

“The Earth only receives about half a billionth of the Sun’s energy.
The Sun is 99.8% of all mass in the solar system… Earth is in the miscellaneous category.
Earth is like a tiny dust mote in a vast darkness.
The way to actually scale civilization is to scale power in space.”

GROK 4.5 RANKS HIGH IN THE LATEST INTELLIGENCE INDEX WITH BEST-IN-CLASS COST EFFICIENCY

According to the latest Artificial Analysis rankings, Grok 4.5 places in the top tier on the Intelligence Index while leading in cost efficiency among frontier models.

Key highlights:

•  Competitive overall intelligence score
•  Significantly lower cost per task than most competitors
•  Excellent token efficiency, making it one of the most practical options for heavy usage
While some models edge it out on raw benchmark scores, Grok 4.5 stands out for delivering strong performance at a much more accessible price point.
This balance of capability and efficiency continues to make Grok 4.5 a strong choice for real-world applications.

BREAKING: South Africa's satellite internet plans are facing new scrutiny as AfriForum calls for greater transparency over the selection of BrainSAT and its UAE partner, Space42. 🇿🇦

• A formal information request has been submitted seeking details about the selection process.
• According to reported comparisons, Thuraya-4 offers speeds of up to 1 Mbps, while Starlink averages around 241 Mbps with much lower latency.
• A 10 Mbps YahClick package is reported to cost R2,033 per month with a 150 GB soft cap and approximately 720 ms latency.
• Uncapped Starlink plans in neighboring countries reportedly start below R500 per month.

The reported performance comparisons and the transparency request were published by MyBroadband and AfriForum.

In case you missed my tour of the Model YL


Tesla Owners Silicon Valley (@teslaownersSV)

🚗 Full walkthrough of the all-new 2026 Tesla Model Y L Launch Series — Tesla’s new long-wheelbase 6-seater electric SUV!

We take you on a complete exterior and interior tour of the stretched Model Y L Premium, showing the extra space and family-friendly features now arriving at select US showrooms.

**Launch Series Key Specs (Model Y L Premium AWD):**
• Seating: 6 passengers in a spacious 2-2-2 configuration with second-row captain’s chairs
• Range: Up to 325 miles EPA estimated
• Performance: Dual-motor all-wheel drive with strong acceleration (0-60 mph in around 5 seconds)
• Battery: Long-range pack
• Wheelbase: Significantly extended for much more rear legroom and third-row comfort
• Key features: Adaptive suspension, premium interior with rear climate controls, V2L (Vehicle-to-Load) capability

**Price:** The US Launch Series starts at $61,990.

The Model Y L is Tesla’s stretched version of the popular Model Y, designed to offer proper 6-passenger seating without moving up to a larger vehicle.

BREAKING: Tesla has officially opened the world's first public 6-stall Tesla Semi Megacharger in Bloomington, California.

• Located about an hour east of Los Angeles.
• The site features six dedicated Megacharger stalls for the Tesla Semi.
• Marks the first publicly accessible Megacharger built specifically for Tesla's electric Class 8 trucks.

Another major milestone as Tesla continues expanding charging infrastructure for the Semi.
